title: Test Yourself: 9 Questions, No Cheating
hook: Are you smarter than most people?
script:
Are you smarter than most people?
Question 1: Which gas do plants absorb from the atmosphere for photosynthesis?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: Carbon Dioxide.
Question 2: Who was the first person to step on the Moon?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: Neil Armstrong.
Question 3: What is the name of the wizarding school in the Harry Potter series?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: Hogwarts.
If you got the first three right, like the video right now.
Question 4: Which classic film features a great white shark terrorizing a beach town?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: Jaws.
Question 5: Which animal is known as the 'King of the Jungle'?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is B: Lion.
Score check: comment SHARP if you are still perfect, RUSTY if you already missed one.
Question 6: Which metal is liquid at room temperature?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is B: Mercury.
Question 7: Which film won the first Best Animated Feature Oscar?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is B: Shrek.
Are you ready for the last question?
Don't forget to follow and comment your score to be on the weekly leaderboard of the top performers.
Question 8: Which letter is missing from all US state names?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is A: Q.
Question 9: How long can a giraffe's tongue be?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is D: 50 cm.
Bonus: double or nothing - keep your score in your head and beat it on the next quiz.
Comment your score out of 9, and follow for a new quiz every day.

items.question: Which gas do plants absorb from the atmosphere for photosynthesis?
items.explanation: Plants use carbon dioxide, water, and sunlight to create their own food.

items.question: Who was the first person to step on the Moon?
items.explanation: Neil Armstrong made history on July 20, 1969, as part of the Apollo 11 mission.

items.question: What is the name of the wizarding school in the Harry Potter series?
items.explanation: Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry is where Harry and his friends learned magic.

items.question: Which classic film features a great white shark terrorizing a beach town?
items.explanation: Steven Spielberg's 1975 film 'Jaws' is famous for its terrifying shark.

items.question: Which animal is known as the 'King of the Jungle'?
items.explanation: Lions are often referred to as the 'King of the Jungle' due to their majestic appearance and power.

items.question: Which metal is liquid at room temperature?
items.explanation: Mercury stays liquid even below zero.

items.question: Which film won the first Best Animated Feature Oscar?
Which letter is missing from all US state names?
items.explanation: No state name contains the letter Q.

items.question: How long can a giraffe's tongue be?
items.explanation: Up to fifty centimeters, almost twenty inches.
